description: Transparent Cycles renders of the Hiperreal catalog models for Best · Xtanco, with floor shadows and screen quadrilaterals.

projection.anchor: Layout origin: Three (col, height, row) maps to Blender (col, -row, height).
projection.rotation: view.rotation = item.rot; Blender Z and Three Y rotate by -rot*pi/2.

render.lighting: Tungsten pendant, warm key and night-window fill over an unseen oak floor.
render.shadows: Separate shadow-catcher pass on a frame 1.55 times wider; none baked in the piece.
render.screens: quad is TL, TR, BR, BL in piece pixels; listed only where the screen faces the camera.
